title: Erdős 257 selected windows: exact one-bit extension and dependent-index coherence

concepts.label: one-bit half-word extension
concepts.note: Appending one Boolean coordinate preserves every old coordinate and exposes the new bit at the terminal index.

concepts.label: support extension normal form
concepts.note: The extended support is either unchanged or gains exactly the new terminal integer.

concepts.label: selected-word index coherence
concepts.note: Dependent proofs of the same selected carry index do not change the chosen word.

concepts.label: finite-word infrastructure boundary
concepts.note: These are exact finite representation laws; they do not establish selected-window existence, strip admissibility, history agreement, or the half-sum conclusion.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED EXTENSION PACKET: extending a half word by a Boolean bit agrees with the parent at every cast-successor index and equals the appended bit at the final index. Membership in its support is exactly old support membership or the new terminal index with bit true; therefore its support is unchanged for false and gains precisely N+1 for true, and restricting the extension recovers the parent word.
statement_nodes.engine: Fin.lastCases computation at old and final indices, followed by extensional support membership analysis and restriction along the canonical inclusion.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Project-local finite-function bookkeeping for appending a Boolean coordinate; no mathematical novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The packet only describes a supplied extension. It does not show that the child satisfies a carry target, remains strip-admissible, or belongs to a coherent protected family.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED DEPENDENT-INDEX COHERENCE: in a SelectedHalfWindow, if two carry indices k and ℓ are equal, then the selected words are equal regardless of which proofs witness their positivity and window bounds.
statement_nodes.engine: Substitute the index equality; proof irrelevance reduces the two dependent applications definitionally.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A dependent-type coherence lemma for the repository's selected-word structure.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem identifies only words already selected at the same index. It asserts neither uniqueness among all admissible words nor agreement between different carry indices.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The index-coherence lemma erases dependent proof choices when extension and restriction identities are composed across selected-window history steps.
